title: Information to action: Nationally integrated AgData Hub is a turning point for Senegal's agriculture
why: ANACIM now produces crop-specific district agro-climatic bulletins combining satellite observations; 32 ministry officials and 149 GTP members use the platform (service, scheduled, reach).

title: Remote Sensing Applications for Rice Production Monitoring in Senegal
publisher: IRRI, ISRA and sarmap (CGIAR Digital Innovation)
why: Pilot with ISRA mapping rice area and yield from Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat in 2023-24 (study/pilot).

title: Inclusive insurance and risk financing in Senegal
publisher: UNDP Insurance and Risk Finance Facility
why: CSE with ANACIM monitors agro-pastoral vegetation by satellite June to October and issues weekly alert bulletins (service, scheduled).

title: Modernizing Agricultural Monitoring in West Africa Using Earth Observation Data
why: CSE and DAPSA staff trained in June 2024 on cropland mapping with Google Earth Engine (study/pilot).

title: Rapport annuel du Groupe de Travail Pluridisciplinaire pour le suivi de la campagne agricole (GTP national) 2023
why: Annual GTP report with NDVI vegetation monitoring and forage balance section (service, scheduled).

title: Suivi de la campagne agro-pastorale 2023: Bilan de fin de saison, Bulletin N 17
why: CSE bulletin builds plant production map and forage balance from satellite NDVI, 42 departments followed (service, scheduled).

title: Innovative Insurance Products Help Farmers Guard Against Climate Shocks
why: CNAAS index insurance uses satellite weather data; 10% of Senegal's farmers covered in 2020 (reach).

title: Projet GEOforAGRI: rapport final
why: Feasibility study finding use of remote sensing in Senegalese institutions marginal outside CSE (stated absence, possibly pre-2019).
